owner_clarification: Original Sa Calobra geography using Pegasus methods, not the fictional island amplitudes.
working_artifact: work/ma2141-sidefx-landscape-v001 (resolve relative to the YACS workspace root)

geographic_verification.status: Experimental Pegasus variation; not accepted as a geographically faithful Sa Calobra terrain.
geographic_verification.interpretation: Original Pegasus noise/erosion settings have large geographic effects. The independent baseline is resampled real DTM; resampling differences are not noise/erosion changes.

adaptations.source: Original island massing replaced by real DTM, imported with SideFX HeightField File.
adaptations.curve: Source-derived Ma-2141 500 m boundary replaces island outline for HeightField Mask by Geometry.
adaptations.height_remap: Three island-specific height remaps bypassed; original values remain visible.
adaptations.resolution: Original 512 -> 1024 -> 2048 sample workflow, over 8 km context.
adaptations.cache: Erosion cache reduced from 5000 to 512 MB per pass; simulation parameters unchanged.
adaptations.composition: SideFX HeightField Layer combines the original noise/erosion result with the real source through the original shrink/blur mask.
adaptations.material: Unavailable Unreal example material assignment bypassed. Terrain-only Houdini visualization.

original_node_comparison.exception: Erosion cache memory only; documented source/masking/bypass/composition adaptations are separate.
